body:
###### [DISCORD](https://discord.gg/xQcGBP8fGG) | [WEBSITE](https://getsoundcloud.app/)


### DON'T KNOW WHICH FILE TO DOWNLOAD? DOWNLOAD FROM THE WEBSITE - https://getsoundcloud.app/download

---

# WHITE THEME

Settings -> Appearance -> Scheme: Dark, White, or System. White is now built into the app itself, not just a theme from the catalog. System changes along with the OS. Themes from the catalog choose their own scheme; Bonbon updated to 2.0.0.

# STAR FREE FOR 3 DAYS

Haven't tried STAR? Open STAR and click "3 days free": UQ, full Go+ tracks, and fast sync. Once per account and computer. 3 days before STAR ends, the app will show how much time is left and let you renew in one click.

# GIFTS AND FRIENDS

STAR can be bought as a gift: choose "As a gift", get a code, and send it to a friend. They open STAR and click "I have a code".

Invite friends: a friend gets STAR with your code, and you both get +7 days. Up to 12 friends per year.

# YEAR IN REVIEW

From December 1 to January 10, Year in Review will appear in Library: how many minutes of music you listened to this year and what you listened to. Requires at least 20 plays.

# NETWORK

Almost everything now goes through relays. The app measures relay speed when loading tracks and switches to a neighboring one if it's 1.5x faster; slow relays rest for 10 minutes. When a server comes back up after an outage, apps don't all hammer it at once, so it recovers faster.

"Network Check" now checks each relay: which services work through it, speed, and a one-line summary.

### More
- Portuguese (Brazil)
- Turkish: normal letters restored and 181 missing strings added
- OBS overlay in Portuguese and Korean
- When Go+ track preview ends, you can see how much of the track remains locked
- If like sync takes long, the app will immediately say it's just minutes with STAR
- Settings -> General -> "Support Report": sends recent requests and errors, no account data
- Same place to disable error reporting to developers

### And much more...

###### [DISCORD](https://discord.gg/xQcGBP8fGG) | [SITE](https://getsoundcloud.app/)

### Не знаешь какой файл качать? Скачай на сайте - https://getsoundcloud.app/download

# HQ FOR EVERYONE

![hq for everyone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zxcloli666/SoundCloud-Desktop/4c48cef41b3cd1f0a660b719fc6cd47834c58f22/8.6.0/03-quality.png)

HQ now plays for everyone, STAR is no longer needed for this. With STAR, UQ opens, maximum quality: if the track doesn't have it, HQ plays. Without STAR, when the server is loaded, some tracks may play in SQ.

# THEMES

![themes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zxcloli666/SoundCloud-Desktop/4c48cef41b3cd1f0a660b719fc6cd47834c58f22/8.6.0/01-themes.png)

Settings -> Appearance -> Themes: catalog, to start there Midnight and Carbon. Click 'Apply', theme turns on for 20 seconds, if you like it, click 'Keep'. Themes update themselves, and if a new version breaks the interface, the app will automatically revert to the previous one. Want your own in the catalog, click 'Make your own'.

# SUPERLIKES

![superlikes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zxcloli666/SoundCloud-Desktop/4c48cef41b3cd1f0a660b719fc6cd47834c58f22/8.6.0/02-superlikes.png)

Hold the heart for half a second, and the track gets a superlike: Wave counts it three times stronger than a regular like. All superlikes are stored in the Library, and on the main page there is a shelf for them. Without STAR you can hold up to 10 at once, with STAR no limit.

# IOS APP

![android and ios](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zxcloli666/SoundCloud-Desktop/4c48cef41b3cd1f0a660b719fc6cd47834c58f22/8.6.0/07-mobile.png)

The mobile app is now available on Android and iOS. Settings -> General -> Mobile apps: there is a link to the IPA and instructions on how to install. You can log in on the phone via QR: Settings -> Account -> Transfer session to another device.

# ZAPRET: ADD SCNATIVE.DEV

The application is moving to the scnative.dev domain. If you have zapret, Flowseal, or your own lists, add scnative.dev next to scnative.space, otherwise the new version may remain without network. 'Network check' will hint at both domains.

### More
- windows: Visual C++ Redistributable is no longer needed; if 8.5.x didn't start, install 8.6.0 from the site over the existing installation.
- likes and superlikes can be arranged as you like: drag the handle or use "Move to top" in the menu.
- equalizer: bars at their own frequencies (previously 4 times lower), preamp, import and export APO, Peace, GraphicEQ.
- manual pitch no longer sounds "like underwater".
- scrolling with mouse wheel over the progress bar can seek the track: 5 seconds, with Shift 15 seconds.
- mini-player from tray without frame, background transparency adjustable.
- app background can take desktop wallpaper and changes with it (except Flatpak).
- skips, likes, and dislikes inside Wave change its next tracks.
- sync shows queue, repeat time, and what SoundCloud didn't accept, with a "Retry" button.
- if login to SoundCloud fails and changes don't go through, the app will ask to log in again.
- uploading your own track explains the error and offers "Log in" or "Retry" without having to choose the file again.
- main page scrolls smoother, and on shelf failure shows "Retry" instead of emptiness.
- updates are found both without login and when GitHub is blocked.
- if an update gets stuck, the window will allow manual file download (will work from the next update).

### And much more...

![release notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zxcloli666/SoundCloud-Desktop/4c48cef41b3cd1f0a660b719fc6cd47834c58f22/8.6.0/poster.webp)

![release notes](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5de1b459-34fb-4831-882b-42283f4cdc14)

# PUBLIC ROOMS

Listening together is now possible not only with a friend via code. You can open a room for everyone; public rooms are visible as a list right in the window, join any. If the host closes the room, the app will automatically pick up the new code. If the spot is taken, it will let you know.

# TRANSITIONS WITHOUT GAPS

The host announces the next track, guests preload it in advance, so the crossfade runs without glitches. Crossfade can be your own or from the host.

# CUSTOM IMAGES IN CSS

You can now drop local images into your CSS. Background, wallpaper, anything you like.

# NETWORK CHECK

New 64K column: each route actually downloads 64 KB, and pro pulls in chunks. If something is throttled, you can see exactly where, plus step-by-step advice for zapret.

### Also
- playlists: you can see that edits are still going to SoundCloud
- settings pages and sections open from the top, back returns to the same place
- covers, previews, and wallpapers go via proxy with fallback to relay and pro
- track title and artist no longer disappear in the player
- playlist editor only accesses SoundCloud for the owner
- stuck connections are dropped earlier, network connection is more stable

### And much more...

## Improved accessibility for Star ⭐ subscribers

In the previous version, there was an issue - if the main host is down, the application cannot verify your subscription status, and because of this, it doesn't switch to the Star backup host.
This has been fixed in this version, and it now checks for the subscription on both hosts.

## OFFLINE PAGE REDESIGN

The offline page has been completely redesigned.

![offline-page](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c6f86117-c75c-4cfe-827c-ba8c8611a3a3)

## HOME PAGE REDESIGNED

Home has been redesigned again!
It looks cooler now...

![home-page](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/423a60c4-e1ce-4ba1-bc23-579b22cfc15d)

![show-track](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e0135732-9803-418a-bcc3-7347ef620bfe)


## Fixed DPI switching

Fixed enabling/disabling the bypass.
Previously, the slider state was not saved - now it is.


## Are these bugs???

### Window won't drag
> Hold the WIN key and drag with the mouse.

### Is there a mini-player?
> Click on the tray and select "Mini Player"

### Likes/playlists are not syncing
> The original SC bans apps, so there are issues with syncing.
> The app will try to retry; this takes time.

### How to download on phone?
> I will make it for mobile in the next month or two.

### Lags heavily
> In upcoming updates, I plan to rewrite the frontend in native Flutter; it will get better.

### NOTHING WORKS!!!! WON'T LOAD, WON'T LOG IN, NOTHING WORKS
> Either open an issue on GitHub (I rarely read it), or open a ticket on Discord (more often, but still rare), or write in HELP in the same Discord.
> And if you use Zapret, add the app domains to it (from the news pin; from the important section in DS). If that doesn't help, run the commands from that same message and send them to the support chat/ticket; even if you're not from Russia, this is generally network monitoring.

Couldn't think of anything else.

###### [DISCORD](https://discord.gg/xQcGBP8fGG) | [WEBSITE](https://soundcloud-desktop.fun/)


![wave-net](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/616f80f0-c6d3-42ae-8093-0d2d3067cc17)

## DEDICATED HOST FOR STAR SUBSCRIBERS ⭐

A dedicated host with infrastructure has been deployed for Star subscribers — now, if the main host is down, people with a subscription can continue using the app.
(The host doesn't die on purpose; there are constant issues, and I'm trying to fix them quickly)

## SEARCH FOR WALLPAPERS DIRECTLY IN THE APP

Now you can search for SCD wallpapers directly in the app!
Four engines have been gathered in one place for this purpose.

![search-wallpapers](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a536340e-ef29-47ed-be8a-2592f590327d)


## ✨ New App Look

Almost all main screens have been rebuilt from scratch — a modern "liquid glass" style, live backgrounds, and neat cards.

- **Home → "Wave".** The old feed is gone, replaced by an infinite personal Wave: a catchy masthead title and a continuous stream of recommendations that adapts to you.
- **Library.** A fresh layout with tabs: likes, follows, history, and playlists. Added "Soundprint" (a visual portrait of your taste), a block for fresh releases from those you follow, and "Continue listening".
- **Search / Discover.** A new catalog with a signature hero, collections, and "Popular Artists" and "Popular Albums" sections.
- **Track Page.** Completely new design in a "room" format: large cover art, inset lyrics, related tracks, and comments.
- **Playlist Page.** New hero, clear track list, curator card.
- **Settings.** Redesigned navigation and section cards — finding what you need is now easier.
- **Account Login.** Updated login screen with a live background and neat offline login.
- **Windows and Dialogs.** A unified style for pop-up windows throughout the app.

---

## 🔍 Search Got Smarter

- **Vibe Search.** Don't remember the title — describe the mood or atmosphere, and the app will pick tracks to match.
- **Search by Lyrics.** Search for a track by a remembered line from the chorus.
- **Smart Hints.** If nothing is found by words, the app will suggest searching by vibe, and vice versa.
- **Catalog by Popularity.** In Discover, artists and albums are now ranked by actual play counts — truly popular content is in view.

---

## 🎵 Player, Queue, and Lyrics

- **Tray Mini-player.** Clicking the tray icon opens a compact glass mini-player: cover art, back/forward, pause — without opening the full window. *(on Windows/macOS; on Linux — tray menu)*
- **Likes play until the end.** If you started your likes, the queue now faithfully plays them to the end before the Wave takes over.
- **Queue and Lyrics.** Redesigned queue and synced lyrics panels — cleaner, more responsive, without freezes.

---

## 🎨 Personalization

- **Online Wallpaper Search.** Right in the settings, you can search for and set wallpapers as the background (categories, tags, color), with adjustable edge dimming and overall background brightness.
- **Performance Modes.** A new switch for your hardware:
  - **Light** — flat and fast, no blur, particles, or background animation.
  - **Balanced** — less blur and fewer particles.
  - **Beauty** — full "liquid glass" design.

---

## ⬇️ Downloads and Cache

- **Download in clean m4a.** Tracks are downloaded in a unified m4a format with embedded cover art.
- **Local Track Cache.** Listened tracks are kept in the cache to play faster and without extra downloads.
- **"Transcode Forge" panel in settings.** The status of the processing engine and queue is visible: new tracks are automatically converted to clean m4a in the background (the ffmpeg engine loads once).

---

## ⚡ Speed and Stability

- **Smooth Scrolling.** Virtual grids rewritten — higher FPS, fewer stutters on large lists.
- **Crash Protection.** Added "insurance": in case of a screen failure, the app no longer crashes to a white screen but recovers gracefully.
- **Faster Home Screen.** Home recommendations are cached — the screen opens noticeably faster.
- **Faster Login.** Authorization at startup has been accelerated.
- **Faster Metadata.** Lyrics, descriptions, and related info from external services are pulled faster.
- **Smarter Recommendations.** The Wave engine has become more accurate in picking tracks and better at considering your tastes.
- **No empty start for new users.** A starting selection appears immediately after registration, while the system doesn't know anything about you yet.

---

## 🔒 Privacy

- **Public / Private.** A visibility toggle has been added for your tracks and playlists — private items are hidden from others in collections, playlists, and search.

name: Release 7.6.0
body:
# SOUND WAVE REWRITTEN

Sound Wave has been rewritten once again!
Now it builds a grid based on your preferences (which artists you listen to), looks at who the artists have collaborated with, analyzes the participants in your likes, and searches for similar content across the grid based on preferences using AI logic.

Also, now when tracks end, they are added to the queue by Sound Wave and continue playing in the same way.

Previously, preferences were mixed together, so they weren't very accurate. 

# Search by SCD Database

Two operating modes have appeared in the search - by the SCD database and by the SoundCloud database.
The first one searches in my database and works quite fast. However, there might be fewer tracks there.
The second one goes to the SoundCloud API and tries to search there. It works slowly and doesn't find everything. Well, just like before.

# Data Storage Logic Rewritten

This is a backend-related change, but now instead of caching responses from SC, they are converted into a proprietary data format.
Because of this, **old clients are incompatible**, but there are fewer problems with data loading in the application.


# Info for those running a worker
(for 0 people)

In this version, the worker:gpu images have been updated, and :gpu has been updated to cuda13, so it no longer supports old video cards (v100, p100), but it does support rtx 50xx.
For legacy support, :gpu-cuda12 has been added; it has been updated to cuda12.8 (previously 12.4), and it also supports rtx 50xx as well as old video cards (v100, p100).

name: Release 7.1.0
body:
In this release...

## SOUND WAVE RECOMMENDATIONS IMPROVEMENTS

COLLAB is now also taken into account — these are the tracks that people similar to you listen to.
This will make recommendations even more accurate!

## STREAMING PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS

Now, the client primarily attempts to fetch tracks directly from SoundCloud instead of through my servers. This will solve the 1% loading issue, but requires you-know-what or bypass tools to be enabled, or being located outside of the Russian Federation.

Streaming for audio response has also been improved.

## IMAGE LOADING IMPROVEMENTS

Images are now not automatically deleted from the cache, so you don't hit the proxy unnecessarily.
This has been resolved.

## APP API SPEEDUP

Added clustering and a TLS gateway in Rust. Due to the Node.js event loop, requests were processed very slowly under high load.

Pagination has also been rewritten to a custom implementation to send fewer requests to the SoundCloud API.

But the main bottleneck is the proxy, and removing it isn't an option — a single IP gets banned within 10 minutes.

## FIXING LOGIN ISSUES

The app has been hit with limits again. Please donate on Boosty so I can buy more Artist Pro subscriptions.
I've added 10 for now, but with over 100 logins in ~5 minutes, they get banned quickly.

## LIKES CACHING HAS MOVED

It is now handled in the settings; also, playlists can no longer be cached.
The likes cache is now saved to a separate folder that is not automatically cleared.

name: Release 7.0.0 | SOUND WAVE
body:
![soundwave-banner](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/826d01ed-71c3-4b35-9802-f82ac8cc28ab)

# SOUND WAVE 🧊

The main innovation of this update is the SOUND WAVE.
No more listening to repetitive tracks, wildly different ones, searching for them yourself, and so on.
Now THE APP BUILDS YOUR WAVE FOR YOU.

And it does it more powerfully than existing analogs, because it takes into account not only the track's beat, but also the VIBE AND LYRICS. 
An additional plus is that there are more tracks on SoundCloud and no requirements to cut out unwanted tracks, so the wave is awesome.

And the more users use the app, the more tracks are noticed, and the more tracks are broken down into vectors and included in the sound wave calculation.

Another plus of the wave is that it plays already downloaded and indexed tracks, so there is no long route {client -> app streaming -> soundcloud}; the track plays directly from storage, already converted into a normal format. 

"Wave by track" is available to everyone for free right now!

![wave-by-track](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a20148b0-b23e-46c3-a02a-132136dd4bbf)

# AI LYRICS 🎵

I haven't forgotten about lyrics either. They have been completely rewritten.

Now, during indexing, the track is searched for on several platforms, and if not found, it gets lyrics from AUDIO via AI.
Some things might not be found or transcribed via AI immediately, but once it's done, it will provide the lyrics directly without a bunch of requests.

There are many re-uploads on SoundCloud, and this has been taken into account!
If the lyrics aren't found by algorithmic search, the AI starts looking for them, building a query that accounts for re-uploads and messy titles.

That's the power.

The frontend part was also rewritten (taken from the @Teiwazik fork).

![lyric-panel](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a5641859-a216-4cd9-9665-137021e9f3ad)

# INFRASTRUCTURE BOOST 🪲

Changed most of the hosts, optimized streaming, performed maintenance, and tuned the hosts.
There should be fewer issues, and the app will become more stable.

# And various smaller fixes/innovations

Can't list them all, but one of the fixes is that image display has been fixed on macOS.

name: Release 6.8.0
body:
# STORAGE IS BACK! 🎉
Previously, the storage was on a host with a 4 TB drive that constantly gave KERNEL ERRORs, resulting in only 1% uptime.
Now the storage has been rewritten to S3 STORAGE. It is inherently cheaper and more reliable. So tracks should become even more stable!

# RE-AUTHORIZATION MODAL ADDED
Have you seen the "Session Expired" error? Most likely, yes.
The solution is simple — log back into your account. But unfortunately, not everyone realized this.
But no worries! Now there's a beautiful modal that shows you what you need to do.
